new_issues_introduced_by_v2.location: blueprint-v2.md line 388 (Fact Disposition Table, row C-0445)
new_issues_introduced_by_v2.description: The C-0445 row rationale phrases the 8-unique-agent math as: '8 consumer agents total (3 from base consumer-mapping — review-architecture-auditor, design-cicd, discovery-codebase-researcher — overlap with the 5-agent ADR-0040 Serena allowlist; the other 5 are non-overlapping). ADR-0040 narrows Serena to a 5-agent allowlist; union with the consumer-mapping = 8 unique.' The '3 from base consumer-mapping overlap with Serena' phrasing is correct (the 3 named agents are in BOTH sets). However, the parallel phrasing 'the other 5 are non-overlapping' is mildly confusing — it actually refers to '5 = 3 base-only + 2 Serena-only', i.e. the union members that are NOT in the overlap. Two cleaner alternative phrasings exist in the SAME document (lines 778 and 996): '5 Serena consumers; 3 of those 5 overlap with the 7-agent base consumer-mapping; the remaining 2 (design-cc, design-codespaces) are net-new — total touched = 8 unique.' That second phrasing is unambiguous; line 388 is reachable but invites a re-derivation.
new_issues_introduced_by_v2.suggestion: Optional cosmetic edit: replace line 388's rationale with the cleaner phrasing already used at lines 778 and 996 — '5 Serena consumers per ADR-0040; 3 of those 5 (review-architecture-auditor, design-cicd, discovery-codebase-researcher) overlap with the 7-agent base consumer-mapping; the remaining 2 (design-cc, design-codespaces) are net-new — union = 8 unique consumer agents'. Non-blocking; arithmetic is correct as-is.

issues.location: blueprint-v2.md line 388 — Fact Disposition Table row C-0445 rationale column
issues.description: Mild rationale-phrasing inconsistency in the 8-unique-agent breakdown. The phrasing '3 from base consumer-mapping ... overlap with the 5-agent ADR-0040 Serena allowlist; the other 5 are non-overlapping' is arithmetically correct (3 overlap + 5 non-overlap = 8) but reads awkwardly because 'non-overlapping' here means union members NOT in the overlap intersection (3 base-only + 2 Serena-only = 5). Two other locations in the SAME document (lines 778 and 996) use a cleaner phrasing: '5 Serena consumers; 3 of those 5 overlap with the 7-agent base; the remaining 2 are net-new — total = 8 unique'.
issues.suggestion: Optional cosmetic edit: align line 388's rationale phrasing with the cleaner formulation already in use at lines 778 and 996. Suggested text: 'Least-privilege per cc-design Principle 5; 5 Serena consumers per ADR-0040; 3 of those 5 (review-architecture-auditor, design-cicd, discovery-codebase-researcher) overlap with the 7-agent base consumer-mapping; the remaining 2 (design-cc, design-codespaces) are net-new — union = 8 unique consumer agents; 36 − 8 = 28 untouched preserve C-0445.' Non-blocking; the arithmetic and reader-resolvable meaning are correct as-is.
